notes: The v1 tables (session, message, part) are no longer written; an upgrade copies each v1 session into session_v2 and session_message and leaves the v1 rows in place (packages/core/src/database/v1-migration.bun.ts).
The copied assistant row keeps its v1 message id and holds the v1 message's tokens, which are its last step's only. The step-finish parts are the per-call figures, so the copy is skipped.
v2 sessions are in session_v2 (renamed from session in migration 20260804233008_loose_psylocke).
A fork copies its parent's rows under new ids with the parent's time_created; rows older than the forked session are those copies.
Rows made through the claude-agent provider ran in the user's claude binary with persistSession on, so they are in Claude Code's own log.
A row still streaming has no tokens; a compaction row's tokens are a total over its calls. Neither is a call here.
next_db.sql is an opencode-next.db holding sessions 2 and 4, its v2 sessions (fork_session_id included) in a table named session; the upgrade copied its rows into opencode.db under the same ids.

not_calls.opencode:msg_v1asst0101: the upgrade's copy of a v1 message
not_calls.opencode:msg_v2cla0001: claude-agent provider, in Claude Code's log
not_calls.opencode:msg_forkevt01_1: the parent's call, copied into the fork
